order.text: Advance to the south end of the bridge and hold it in line, facing north, astride the High road. Fire on any enemy that tries to cross. Do not cross the river.

Move up to the river bank about 150 paces east of the bridge and form line facing north so that your fire sweeps the bridge. Support the 1st Battalion; if it is pressed hard, close on the bridge and help hold it.
Cross the bridge and scout north along the High road to find the enemy. Do not engage. Report what you see, and be back south of the bridge before the enemy reaches it.
Ride ahead down the High road to the river and find out whether the bridge is held. Report what you see. Do not get caught by infantry; fall back on the Vanguard if fired on.
Advance down the High road to the bridge, deploy in line on the north bank and take the bridge. Press the attack across it if it is weakly held.
Follow the Vanguard down the east side of the High road and form line on the north bank east of the bridge, to support its attack with fire.

order.text: Hold the south end of the bridge at all costs. Keep up your fire on any enemy on the bridge or the far bank. Spare your powder: fire by volleys at close range only.

Close in to the river bank about 80 paces east of the bridge and open fire on the enemy battalion at the north end of the bridge. If the enemy storms the bridge, take his column in the flank with your fire.
You are cut off on the far bank. Charge the rear of the enemy battalion on the bridge while it is engaged with the 1st Battalion, then rejoin us south of the river.
Storm the bridge now. Form column on the road, give one volley, then cross at the bayonet and drive the enemy battalion off the south end. Once across, hold the south end of the bridge.

Form line on the north bank just east of the bridge and fire on the enemy battalion at the south end to cover the Vanguard's assault. When the Vanguard is across, follow it over the bridge and form on its left.
Wait at the north end of the bridge behind the Vanguard. When the Vanguard has cleared the south end, cross and fall on any enemy who breaks. Do not charge formed infantry.
